This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Already resolved: the pagination bug was fixed in 3.2.1 (PR #901), which changed the reports query to `ORDER BY created_at DESC, id` so same-timestamp reports no longer shuffle across pages. The current code in src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts already has this ordering, and the reporter confirmed the fix after upgrading, so no further change is needed.
